From 9723b2cca1f0e980c53156b52ea73b93966b3c8a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geetha sowjanya <gakula@marvell.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2023 13:34:31 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] octeontx2-af: Fix mcs sa cam entries size

On latest silicon versions SA cam entries increased to 256.
This patch fixes the datatype of sa_entries in mcs_hw_info
struct to u16 to hold 256 entries.

Fixes: 080bbd19c9dd ("octeontx2-af: cn10k: mcs: Add mailboxes for port related operations")
Signed-off-by: Geetha sowjanya <gakula@marvell.com>
Reviewed-by: Wojciech Drewek <wojciech.drewek@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/marvell/octeontx2/af/mbox.h b/drivers/net/ethernet/marvell/octeontx2/af/mbox.h
index 6845556581c3..5df42634ceb8 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/marvell/octeontx2/af/mbox.h
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/marvell/octeontx2/af/mbox.h
@@ -1945,7 +1945,7 @@ struct mcs_hw_info {
 	u8 tcam_entries;	/* RX/TX Tcam entries per mcs block */
 	u8 secy_entries;	/* RX/TX SECY entries per mcs block */
 	u8 sc_entries;		/* RX/TX SC CAM entries per mcs block */
-	u8 sa_entries;		/* PN table entries = SA entries */
+	u16 sa_entries;		/* PN table entries = SA entries */
 	u64 rsvd[16];
 };
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `mbox.h`**
   - The datatype of the `sa_entries` field in the `mcs_hw_info` struct has been changed from `u8` to `u16`. This change allows the struct to accommodate 256 entries for SA cam entries, which have increased in size on the latest silicon versions.

### Relationships
- The modification in `mbox.h` directly addresses a bug related to the size of SA cam entries, as indicated by the fix reference to a previous commit (`080bbd19c9dd`). By changing the datatype from `u8` to `u16`, the patch ensures that the `mcs_hw_info` struct can now correctly represent the increased number of entries, thereby resolving the issue introduced in the earlier commit.

Here is the commit message:
octeontx2-af: Fix mcs sa cam entries size

On latest silicon versions SA cam entries increased to 256.
This patch fixes the datatype of sa_entries in mcs_hw_info
struct to u16 to hold 256 entries.

Fixes: 080bbd19c9dd ("octeontx2-af: cn10k: mcs: Add mailboxes for port related operations")
Signed-off-by: Geetha sowjanya <gakula@marvell.com>
Reviewed-by: Wojciech Drewek <wojciech.drewek@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the `sa_entries` field in the `mcs_hw_info` struct being defined as a `u8`, which can only hold values up to 255. With the increase in SA cam entries to 256 in the latest silicon versions, this datatype was insufficient, leading to potential overflow or incorrect handling of the entries.

Here is the patch:
 	u8 secy_entries;	/* RX/TX SECY entries per mcs block */
 	u8 sc_entries;		/* RX/TX SC CAM entries per mcs block */
-	u8 sa_entries;		/* PN table entries = SA entries */
+	u16 sa_entries;		/* PN table entries = SA entries */
 	u64 rsvd[16];
 };

Reason:
The `sa_entries` field was defined as a `u8`, which can only hold values from 0 to 255. With the increase in SA cam entries to 256, this datatype is insufficient, leading to potential overflow or incorrect handling of the entries.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
u16 sa_entries;		/* PN table entries = SA entries */
```
Reason:
Changing the datatype of `sa_entries` from `u8` to `u16` allows it to hold values up to 65535, which is sufficient to accommodate the new requirement of 256 SA cam entries, thus preventing overflow and ensuring correct handling of the entries.
